title: Count the Posts
kicker: Under the Pond · Floor One, Part 2
blurb: The map is gone, so Marcus uses someone else's exercise book: a table where the cart did not stop evenly. Divide each jump in height by its own jump in posts. Then one last slope from two points, with one incident left, in the same order top and bottom.
note: Captions stay on. Pause after Doug says "You have not looked at the posts" and ask what the incident slip will say. At the stairs, pause on "Stop." and ask what Marcus is about to get wrong. At the end, say the three helmet lines together.
